name: Schema Markup
description: Adds JSON-LD structured data to every published page: your Organization or LocalBusiness (address, opening hours, phone), the WebSite, and a BlogPosting for posts, so Google can show rich results.

panels.title: Schema Markup
panels.description: Structured data for search engines. It is added to the head of every published page and is invisible to visitors.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Add structured data
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: type
fields.title: What you are
fields.description: A local business adds address, opening hours and a map-ready listing.

fields.name: name
fields.title: Name
fields.description: Leave empty to use the name in your home page title.

fields.name: site-url
fields.title: Site address
fields.description: For example https://example.com. Leave empty to use each page's canonical address.

fields.name: logo
fields.title: Logo URL
fields.description: A square or wide image, at least 112 pixels. A path like /media/logo.png works when the site address is set.

fields.name: country
fields.title: Country
fields.description: Two-letter code, for example NL or US.

fields.name: hours
fields.title: Opening hours
fields.description: One line per range, for example "Mo-Fr 09:00-17:30" or "Sa 10:00-16:00". Days: Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa Su.

fields.name: price-range
fields.title: Price range
fields.description: For example €€. Only used for local businesses.

fields.name: same-as
fields.title: Social profiles
fields.description: One address per line: your LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook or other official pages.

fields.name: post-paths
fields.title: Posts live under
fields.description: Pages whose address starts with one of these, comma-separated, are marked up as blog posts. "blog" matches blog-my-first-post; the page called blog itself is not a post.

fields.name: author
fields.title: Default author
fields.description: Named as the author of posts. Leave empty to credit the organization.
